style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. For native3D assets use real Blender renders; this existing2D asset retains honest raster source and editable packing recipe. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.representation: Existing2D raster and deterministic packing, with exact raster provenance. No fabricated3D metadata.

criteria.visibleSuccess: One caramel-brown eel fillet over compact warm white rice, crossed by one continuous dark olive-green nori band, on one small ivory round ceramic serving plate. The fillet arch, rice mass, band and complete rim form a coherent appetizing serving. No garnish, chopsticks, added food, labels, scenery or ground shadow.
failureExamples: band resembles an empty black hole
eel becomes salmon-orange stripes or several separate toppings
plate becomes a second rice mass
food floats above plate

criteria.visibleSuccess: Preserve useful target design gains: a thick rounded eel arch with an understandable edge/underside, compact plump rice clusters supporting it, and a continuous smooth shallow ceramic dish with a deliberate rim/front thickness. Improve weak source construction when useful; exact old silhouette, decorative part count and tiny surface marks are not constraints.
failureExamples: thin brittle eel ends
melted or torn food contours
unmotivated extra layers
warped or broken elliptical rim
rice occupies or obscures all plate surface

criteria.visibleSuccess: Broad warm light makes the caramel, ivory and olive forms readable through smooth midtones. Eel glaze has a few coherent honey/caramel ribbons and bounded reflections; rice feels softly rounded; nori has a restrained olive material response; the ceramic rim carries a gentle continuous reflection. The image feels warmer and softer than the original, while retaining legible depth. No preferred horizontal world light or directional ground cast shadow.
failureExamples: dense white pinpoint glare dominates eel
photographic mottled speckle competes with form
cool patchwork plate shading dominates
gloss becomes bloom or halo
flat undifferentiated orange food

criteria.visibleSuccess: The front/lower nori retains visible olive midtones and a coherent wrapped edge instead of a broad near-black dead area. Eel undersides, tail and contact seams may use deep brown locally when they explain thickness; they do not swallow the food shape. Rice reads as selected clustered grains at66px and40px, with detail subordinate to overall volume.
failureExamples: lower nori is a featureless black rectangle
dark eel lip merges with band into one mass
sparkle or texture noise replaces rice structure
every seam is brightened away so layers merge

criteria.visibleSuccess: At66px standalone and40px bubble-food width, the caramel top, pale rice, dark olive band and complete pale plate remain distinct. At CELL32, use the full registered48x80px frame: dish is about16.5px wide and food inside the preference balloon10px wide. These tiny contexts retain a compact caramel/pale/dark-band recipe grouping and plate/balloon separation; individual grains need not survive. Show true-size views and enlarged inspections, clearly labeled.
failureExamples: alpha-silhouette enlargement misrepresented as game size
candidate compared at a larger food scale than original
band disappears or consumes all top color
food merges with blank balloon or plate
old dish art silently used in a new-art context

criteria.visibleSuccess: On light, gray and dark backgrounds at true size and enlarged, contour is clean with no detached debris, white fringe, black fringe, external glow, or visible alpha box. Inspect both raw alpha>0 and alpha>8 bounds. An authorized once-only lossless rectangle crop may produce the canonical effective source, preserving original raw/provenance and every interior RGBA byte, with no threshold alpha deletion, painting, second crop or use-specific fit.
requiredEvidence: native exports and reduced composite images
failureExamples: raw target outliers silently alter held-plane UV/aspect/anchor
Pillow repaint or threshold-removal described as packing
canonical source is cropped again by a consumer

lockedTechnicalContract.registrationCheck: Packing code must reproduce original exactly; candidate center/scale/frame derive from same deterministic recipe. Source aspect-dependent height is uniformly scaled, not stretched or manually fitted.
